fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami municipal governance and civic finance, with prominent coverage of downtown traffic changes (two-way vs. one-way streets), parking congestion, and public safety. Reports and opinion pieces address Miami Beach mayoralty politics and the upcoming election, warnings about seasonal crime targeting tourists, and local business/tourism conditions at the start of the winter season. Health-related coverage discusses concerns about Miami’s milk supply and Jackson Memorial Hospital staff policies. Entertainment and local events include dog/greyhound racing promotions and theater/club advertisements, along with assorted local notes and political advertisements.
